tagline: Complex AI. Explained visually. Built practically.
title: Generative AI Explained Simply
disclosure: Fictional teaching scenario. Wouri Express and its people are invented; the setting draws on documented conditions in Douala, Cameroon.

onScreen.text: Friday, six in the evening. Mbella still has to write the weekly report.
onScreen.emphasis: Same report, every week, from the same messy notes.

lines.speaker: tanyi
lines.text: Friday, six in the evening at Wouri Express. The deliveries are done. Mbella still has to write the weekly report for her customers.

lines.speaker: tanyi
lines.text: Same report every week, from the same messy driver notes. This is exactly what generative AI is for. Let me show you what it is.

onScreen.title: Generative AI Explained Simply
onScreen.subtitle: AI Fundamentals · Lesson 2 · The weekly report at Wouri Express, Douala

messages.text: Mbella: I have the delay counts from last lesson. Writing them up nicely takes me an hour.
Mbella: My customers want plain words, not a spreadsheet.

ui.title: Ndedi's rule
lines: Every number in the report comes from my sheet
The words can be drafted; the numbers cannot

lines.speaker: amara
lines.text: Tanyi, Mbella has the counts. Writing them into a report her customers can read takes her an hour every Friday.

lines.speaker: tanyi
lines.text: And Ndedi, her dispatcher, has one rule: every number comes from her sheet. Words can be drafted. Numbers cannot.

left.title: AI that sorts
items: Picks a label: port, road, customer

lines.speaker: tanyi
lines.text: Last lesson, AI sorted messages into causes. It chose from a list. Generative AI is different: it produces something new.

lines.speaker: tanyi
lines.text: Give it the counts and the notes, and it writes sentences that did not exist before. A draft report in plain words.

lines.speaker: gatekeeper
lines.text: New words, yes. New numbers, never. Ndedi's rule is now our rule.

lines.speaker: tanyi
lines.text: A generative model was trained on huge amounts of text. It learned how reports, emails and summaries usually read.

lines.speaker: tanyi
lines.text: You give it your numbers and your notes. It generates sentences that fit them, one word after another.

lines.speaker: tanyi
lines.text: It is a draft. A person reads it, fixes it, and sends it. The same machine can generate images, code or audio the same way.

ui.title: Kito's instruction
lines: Write for pharmacy and shop customers
Plain English, under one hundred words

ui.subject: Wouri Express · Week 36
body: This week we completed 212 deliveries, 181 on time.
Port gate queues on Tuesday and Thursday mornings caused 11 late deliveries.
Rain flooded the Bonabéri road and delayed 6 more.

lines.speaker: kito
lines.text: I take the numbers from Ndedi's sheet. Two hundred and twelve deliveries, one hundred and eighty-one on time.

lines.speaker: amara
lines.text: And the instruction tells you who reads it and how long it should be. Like briefing a new assistant.

lines.speaker: kito
lines.text: Then I generate the draft. Plain sentences, the causes from the notes, only the numbers I was given.

ui.subject: Wouri Express · Week 36
body: Another excellent week with a ninety-eight percent on-time rate.
Our fleet of modern trucks handled every route smoothly.

ui.title: Check against the sheet
lines: Modern fleet: not in any note

items.text: Numbers are copied from the sheet by code
The model writes only the sentences

lines.speaker: hallucinator
lines.text: Another excellent week with a ninety-eight percent on-time rate. Our modern fleet handled every route smoothly.

lines.speaker: kito
lines.text: One hundred and eighty-one of two hundred and twelve is about eighty-five percent. And nobody wrote modern fleet. I rewrite it.

lines.speaker: tanyi
lines.text: Generative AI makes text that sounds right. Sounding right is not being right. So the numbers are pasted in by code, and the model only writes around them.

messages.text: Draft ready. Numbers from the sheet, causes from the notes. Two hundred and twelve deliveries, one hundred and eighty-one on time.
Mbella: Add that Thursday port runs move to the afternoon from next week.

lines.speaker: kito
lines.text: Mbella reads the draft, adds one line about the new Thursday schedule, and the hour becomes two minutes.

lines.speaker: gatekeeper
lines.text: Forty customers receive this. A person presses send. Never the model.

lines.text: Same pattern elsewhere: a job post drafted from the requirements, patient instructions from a doctor's notes, product descriptions from a price list.

onScreen.title: Who owns this?
items: Ndedi's sheet stays the single source of numbers
Mbella signs every report that goes out
Customer names never leave the company's tools
Accountable: Wouri Express, not the model

lines.speaker: gatekeeper
lines.text: Ndedi's sheet stays the only source of numbers. Mbella signs every report. Customer names never leave the company's own tools.

lines.speaker: tanyi
lines.text: Generative AI: a model that learned how text reads, producing new drafts from your facts. Your facts, its words, your signature.
